title: Expiry
description: For temporary and demo apps. A notice is written {{notice}} hours before, the app is stopped at the expiry, and deleted {{grace}} hours later. Apps with volumes, linked databases or a protected environment are only stopped unless delete data is set.

state.noticed: Expires {{at}}. The notice is in the audit log.
state.stopped: Stopped at expiry. Deleted after {{after}} unless cleared.

cleared: Expiry cleared, any pending delete is cancelled
hint: Up to {{days}} days ahead. Clearing always cancels a pending delete; a stopped app stays stopped until started.
deleteDisabled: Delete disabled by operator: expired apps are only stopped.
